The review identifies the core structural problem: three components and their styles are all mixed into one file. The fix is to split each subcomponent (`SettingsItem`, `SignOutButton`) into its own file under a `components/` subdirectory, leaving `Settings.tsx` as a clean screen-level file that only handles layout and imports. Each file then owns only its own `StyleSheet`, and the subcomponents become reusable across the codebase. An optional barrel export (`components/index.ts`) is also included for cleaner imports if the directory grows.
